name: Qwen3-235B-A22B
notes: Vendor: 235B total / 22B activated; safetensors total 235.09B; our config arithmetic gives 235.0B / 22.1B, both matching the vendor figures to ~0.5%. kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 94 layers x 4 kv_heads x head_dim 128 x 2 x 2 = 94 x 4 x 128 x 2 x 2 = 192,512 B/token (188 KiB). GQA, not MLA. That 188 KiB is the headline number in this record: DeepSeek-V3 does 37B active in 68.6 KiB/token while this does 22B active in 188 KiB/token - 2.8x the KV for 60% of the compute. On a long-context workload the MoE advantage nearly disappears. MoE: 128 experts, 8 per token, no shared expert. hidden 4096, intermediate 12288, moe_intermediate_size 1536, all 94 layers MoE (no first_k_dense_replace), gqa_ratio 16 (64 heads / 4 kv heads). Context 40960 with rope_theta 1000000, no rope_scaling. Apache-2.0. Weights are ~470 GB in bf16, so this is a multi-node or heavily quantized model.
